stem.text: The graph shows the variation in extension with force for a sample of rubber.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis force and horizontal axis extension, origin 0. Two curves start at the origin and rise, labelled force is applied (upper curve) and force is removed (lower curve).

stem.text: The top line shows the variation in extension as a force is applied.
The bottom line shows the variation in extension as the force is removed.
What is represented by the area between the two lines?

A.text: the work done as the force is applied

B.text: the work done as the force is applied minus the work done as the force is removed

C.text: the work done as the force is removed

D.text: the work done as the force is removed plus the work done as the force is applied
